caption:
Can you now take 90% of your PF? | EPF Withdrawal Rules Explained

On 19 Nov 2026 the EPFO board approved cutting the minimum balance you must leave in your PF on a partial withdrawal from 25% to 10%.
Illustrative: ₹5 lakh eligible PF balance. Before, up to ₹3,75,000 could come out. Now up to ₹4,50,000, and ₹50,000 stays in your account.
Purpose (medical, education, marriage, housing and other listed needs) and service conditions still apply. Check the EPFO portal for when the change applies to your claim.
Can take is not should take: what stays keeps earning PF interest for retirement.
